chunks.text: Crude oil is pumped from tank T-101 by charge pump P-101A through suction valve XV-101 to the preheat train and heater F-101. A minimum flow line with FV-101 returns flow to suction on low flow. Seal flush follows API Plan 11 with quench.

SEQ-101 start permissives: 1 Suction valve open (ZSO-101); 2 Seal flush established (dP > 1.5 bar) (PDI-101); 3 No active trip / reset done (DCS reset). Trips: PSLL-101 Suction pressure LOW-LOW < 0.3 barg; FSLL-101 Discharge flow LOW-LOW < 90 m3/h for 30 s; TSHH-101 Bearing temperature HIGH-HIGH > 95 degC; VSHH-101 Bearing vibration HIGH-HIGH > 9 mm/s.
Crude Charge Pump P-101A: overall length 3200 mm, height 1100 mm, centreline elevation 450 mm, dry weight 4200 kg, motor 200 kW.
Crude Charge Pump P-101A is at plot grid B-2, EL +0.00, footprint 5.0 x 3.5 m.
OPL-P-101A-01 Mechanical seal flush (API Plan 11) check (P-101A). Class: Trouble Case. Objective: Confirm seal flush dP above 1.5 bar before start. Fluid: Crude oil. Design 24 barg 120 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Line up flush to seal chamber (check: LOTO verified). Step 2. Check PDI-101 reads 1.5 to 2.5 bar (check: Within range). Step 3. Check no leak at seal (check: Dry).
Symptom: Crude leak at seal gland Cause: Flush orifice plugged Action: Cleaned orifice, replaced seal cartridge
Confirm seal flush dP above 1.5 bar before start.
OPL-P-101A-02 Pump start-up and priming (P-101A). Class: Basic Knowledge. Objective: Prime and vent the pump before every start. Fluid: Crude oil. Design 24 barg 120 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Open suction valve XV-101 (check: Valve open (ZSO-101)). Step 2. Vent casing at N5 (check: Liquid at vent). Step 3. Start motor and open discharge slowly (check: Flow above 90 m3/h).
Symptom: Pump does not build pressure Cause: Air in casing Action: Re-vent and re-prime
Prime and vent the pump before every start.

Preheated crude passes through the radiant and convection coils of fired heater F-101 and leaves at 355 degC to column C-101. Fuel gas is fired through burners under flame scanner and pilot protection. Tube skin temperature is monitored by TE-201 to TE-208.

SEQ-201 start permissives: 1 Furnace purge complete (5 min) (DCS purge); 2 Pilot flame proven (BSL-201); 3 Pass flow above minimum (FT-201). Trips: FSLL-201 Pass flow LOW-LOW < 40 % of normal; TSHH-201 Tube skin temperature HIGH-HIGH > 650 degC; PSLL-201 Fuel gas pressure LOW-LOW < 0.8 barg; BSL-201 Flame failure Loss of flame.
Crude Heater F-101: overall length 14000 mm, height 16000 mm, centreline elevation 0 mm, dry weight 185000 kg.
Crude Heater F-101 is at plot grid C-2, EL +0.00, footprint 14.0 x 8.0 m.

OPL-F-101-01 Furnace purge before light-off (F-101). Class: Basic Knowledge. Objective: Purge the firebox for at least five minutes before any light-off. Fluid: Crude oil / fuel gas. Design 35 barg 380 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.

Step 1. Confirm all fuel gas valves closed (check: XV-201 closed). Step 2. Start forced draft fan and purge (check: Purge timer complete). Step 3. Light pilots and prove flame (check: BSL-201 healthy).
Symptom: Flame will not prove Cause: Dirty scanner lens Action: Clean the lens and re-check
Purge the firebox for at least five minutes before any light-off.

Hot crude from heater F-101 flashes in column C-101. Naphtha leaves as overhead vapour to condenser E-102, kerosene and diesel are drawn as side streams, and residue leaves from the bottom. Stripping steam is injected below the bottom tray. Column pressure is controlled by PIC-301.

SEQ-301 start permissives: 1 Bottom level normal (LT-301); 2 Stripping steam available (FT-301). Trips: PSHH-301 Top pressure HIGH-HIGH > 2.4 barg; LSHH-301 Bottom level HIGH-HIGH > 85 %; LSLL-301 Bottom level LOW-LOW < 15 %.
Crude Distillation Column C-101: overall length 3800 mm, height 42000 mm, centreline elevation 0 mm, dry weight 210000 kg.
Crude Distillation Column C-101 is at plot grid D-2, EL +0.00, footprint 8.0 x 8.0 m.

OPL-C-101-01 Column pressure excursion response (C-101). Class: Trouble Case. Objective: Know the first three actions when column pressure rises. Fluid: Crude oil / naphtha / steam. Design 3.5 barg 400 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Confirm PT-301 and PSHH-301 readings (check: Both agree). Step 2. Reduce heater firing (check: Pressure falls). Step 3. Check condenser cooling water (check: Flow normal).
Symptom: Column pressure rising Cause: Condenser cooling lost Action: Restore cooling water, reduce firing
Know the first three actions when column pressure rises.

Naphtha vapour from column C-101 is condensed in overhead condenser E-102 against cooling water from tower CT-701. Condensate flows to reflux drum V-102. Cooling water flow is controlled by TV-401 on the outlet temperature.
SEQ-401 start permissives: 1 Cooling water flow established (FT-401). Trips: FSLL-401 Cooling water flow LOW-LOW < 400 m3/h; TSHH-401 Condensate temperature HIGH-HIGH > 80 degC.
Overhead Condenser E-102: overall length 7500 mm, height 2200 mm, centreline elevation 1500 mm, dry weight 48000 kg.
Overhead Condenser E-102 is at plot grid D-3, EL +4.50, footprint 9.0 x 3.0 m.
OPL-E-102-01 Tube leak detection (E-102). Class: Trouble Case. Objective: Detect a tube leak before cooling water is contaminated. Fluid: Naphtha vapour / cooling water. Design 3.5 barg 150 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Sample cooling water return (check: Hydrocarbon free). Step 2. Check shell pressure PT-401 (check: Stable).
Symptom: Hydrocarbon in cooling water Cause: Tube leak Action: Isolate bundle, pressure test, plug tubes
Detect a tube leak before cooling water is contaminated.

Condensed naphtha from E-102 collects in reflux drum V-102. A boot separates sour water. Reflux pumps return part of the naphtha to the column top and the rest goes to the naphtha stabiliser. Off gas leaves to the fuel gas system under pressure control PV-501.

SEQ-501 start permissives: 1 Level in normal band (20 to 80 %) (LT-501); 2 No active trip / reset done (DCS reset). Trips: LSHH-501 Drum level HIGH-HIGH > 85 %; LSLL-501 Drum level LOW-LOW < 10 %; PSHH-501 Drum pressure HIGH-HIGH > 2.5 barg.
Reflux Drum V-102: overall length 7000 mm, height 2900 mm, centreline elevation 1800 mm, dry weight 14500 kg.
Reflux Drum V-102 is at plot grid E-3, EL +1.50, footprint 8.0 x 3.0 m.
OPL-V-102-01 Boot water draw-off (V-102). Class: Basic Knowledge. Objective: Drain the boot only against the interface level LT-502. Fluid: Naphtha / fuel gas / sour water. Design 3.5 barg 150 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Check LT-502 interface level (check: Above 40 %). Step 2. Open drain slowly (check: Water only at sight glass). Step 3. Close before hydrocarbon shows (check: Drain closed).
Symptom: Hydrocarbon in sour water Cause: Drain left open Action: Close drain, notify supervisor
Drain the boot only against the interface level LT-502.

Crude oil is received into fixed roof tank T-101 and fed to the unit by charge pump P-101A. Tank level is measured by radar LT-601 with an independent high-high switch. A pressure vacuum vent protects the roof.
SEQ-601 start permissives: 1 Level in normal band (LT-601). Trips: LSHH-601 Tank level HIGH-HIGH > 92 %; LSLL-601 Tank level LOW-LOW < 8 %.
Crude Storage Tank T-101: overall length 40000 mm, height 14000 mm, centreline elevation 0 mm, dry weight 260000 kg.
Crude Storage Tank T-101 is at plot grid A-2, EL +0.00, footprint 42.0 x 42.0 m.

OPL-T-101-01 Tank level reading and verification (T-101). Class: Basic Knowledge. Objective: Cross-check radar level against the high-high switch before filling. Fluid: Crude oil. Design 0.02 barg 60 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Read LT-601 (check: Matches gauge). Step 2. Check LSHH-601 test status (check: Tested in date).
Symptom: Level reads high but tank is not full Cause: Radar affected by foam Action: Verify by manual dip
Cross-check radar level against the high-high switch before filling.

Warm cooling water from condenser E-102 is distributed over the fill of cooling tower CT-701 and cooled by the induced draft fan. Cold water collects in the basin and is pumped back to the users. Make-up water enters on basin level control.
SEQ-701 start permissives: 1 Basin level normal (LT-701). Trips: VSHH-701 Fan vibration HIGH-HIGH > 9 mm/s; LSLL-701 Basin level LOW-LOW < 20 %.
Cooling Tower Fan CT-701: overall length 14000 mm, height 9000 mm, centreline elevation 8000 mm, dry weight 42000 kg, motor 90 kW.
Cooling Tower Fan CT-701 is at plot grid F-2, EL +0.00, footprint 14.0 x 14.0 m.
OPL-CT-701-01 Fan vibration check (CT-701). Class: Trouble Case. Objective: Check fan vibration trend weekly. Fluid: Cooling water / air. Design atm 40 degC.
Safety: Apply LOTO and verify zero energy; Use gas detector in flammable service Tools: Torque wrench; Gas detector.
Step 1. Read VT-701 (check: Below 5 mm/s). Step 2. Inspect fan blades (check: No cracks).
Symptom: High fan vibration Cause: Blade imbalance Action: Rebalance blades and re-check
Check fan vibration trend weekly.
Heater F-101 radiant coil replaced during the 2025 turnaround. New tube skin thermocouples TE-201 to TE-208 installed. Tube skin high-high trip setpoint confirmed at 650 degC.
